title: Event key visual: striped numerals on the pool, a tilted title postcard over their corner, a white wall with a palm shadow
use: The landscape key visual of a limited event whose name has a time, date or number in it. Not for character art: the pool and the numerals are the subject.

time_size.note: numeral height x H (440 px at 1080p: 22:1 against 20 px body)

palm.note: drawn fan-palm shadow on the wall (ignored when the palm slot is filled)

tagline.default: 下午三点，泳池只剩一个人，和一封没写完的信。

subtitle.default: 白昼公馆 · 夏日限定活动

sticker_line.default: 6★ 澄夏 · 救生员 同步开启

palm.note: optional cut palm silhouette (PNG with alpha), drawn at 30% deep teal on the wall

relations: The numerals sit on the pool at the left, about 1:22 to the body text; the title postcard overlaps their last digit by a corner, never more.
Pool line at 0.41 H with a paper coping band and its 26% shadow; sky above, pool below.
Lemon only on the sun and the banner sticker.
Brand and tagline top left on the sky; the wall with its window grid and palm shadow top right.
decoration: Striped sun, window grid, diving board, pool tiles, palm shadow: all drawn; the palm can come from a cut photograph through the palm slot.

provenance.corpus: gacha-event case v3 (白昼公馆「三点钟的泳池」): our own original fictional gacha event in the citypop-sleeve grammar
